headlines.title: Ross Stores completes 2026 expansion with 51 new locations
headlines.summary: The recent openings comprise 41 Ross Dress for Less outlets and 10 dd’s DISCOUNTS sites.

headlines.title: Wells Fargo names top retailing stock amid shifting market dynamics
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Wells Fargo has identified Burlington Stores as its top pick in the off-price retail sector, citing favorable valuation and margin improvement potential, while expressing caution on competitors TJX Companies and Ross Stores despite varying momentum across the group.

headlines.title: Ross opens 51 new stores
headlines.summary: The off-price retailer completed its fiscal year 2026 store growth plan of opening 115 new locations, including its first in Massachusetts.

headlines.title: Ross Stores Opens 51 New Locations
headlines.summary: Ross Stores, Inc. (Nasdaq: ROST) recently opened 41 Ross Dress for Less® ("Ross") and 10 dd's DISCOUNTS® stores across 17 different states in September and October. These new locations complete the Company's store growth plans for fiscal 2026, with the addition of 115 new locations throughout the year.

headlines.title: Zacks.com featured highlights include Micron Technology, Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria, Ross Stores, VICI Properties and PACCAR
headlines.summary: Amid volatile markets, Micron, Banco Bilbao, Ross Stores, VICI Properties and PACCAR stand out for strong returns on equity and earnings growth potential.

description: Ross Stores, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates off-price retail apparel and home fashion stores under the Ross Dress for Less and dd's DISCOUNTS brands in the United States. The company offers designer apparel, accessories, footwear, and home-fashioned products for the entire family. It sells its products to middle income households and households with lower to more moderate incomes. Ross Stores, Inc. was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Dublin, California.
